content:
Meta is actively rolling out a number of new iPhone apps this summer, with the latest being Facebook Creator Studio.

Meta's new iPhone app is described as "an AI-powered daily companion for Facebook creators."

Meta describes the new iPhone app as "an AI-powered daily companion for Facebook creators."

Here's a look at Facebook Creator Studio:

Meta says the new Facebook app is designed to make it easier for users to explore their interests, with a more personalised Feed, Marketplace, Reels and search, plus built-in access to Meta AI.

The app also puts more emphasis on connecting with friends, creators and communities through Groups, friend privacy settings, and private sharing of posts and Reels.

The new app joins a series of recently launched features, including Seller and StoryKit, the latter of which is currently only being tested in limited markets.

Facebook Creator Studio for iPhone is now available on the App Store.
